CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_feed_v2(p_user_id uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(post_id uuid, feed_score numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
  SELECT
    p.id AS post_id,
    (COALESCE(uis.interest_score, 0) * 10)
    + (COALESCE(pm.views, 0) * 1)
    + (COALESCE(pm.completions, 0) * 3)
    + (COALESCE(p.likes_count, 0) * 5)
    + COALESCE(pm.post_conversion_score, 0)
    AS feed_score
  FROM posts p
  LEFT JOIN post_metrics pm ON pm.post_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COALESCE(MAX(score), 0) AS interest_score
    FROM user_interest_scores
    WHERE user_id = p_user_id
      AND category IN (
        SELECT LOWER(t) FROM unnest(p.interests) AS t
      )
  ) uis ON TRUE
  WHERE (p.video_url IS NOT NULL OR p.poster_url IS NOT NULL)
    AND p.hidden_at is null and not exists (select 1 from public.profiles banned_creator where banned_creator.id=p.creator_id and banned_creator.banned_at is not null) AND p.removed_at IS NULL
  ORDER BY feed_score DESC, p.created_at DESC
  LIMIT p_limit
  OFFSET p_offset;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_profile_rating(p_profile_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(avg_rating numeric, review_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    COALESCE(p.review_rating, 0)::NUMERIC(3, 2) as avg_rating,
    COALESCE(p.review_count, 0)::BIGINT as review_count
  FROM public.profiles p
  WHERE p.id = p_profile_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.interests_to_text_array(j jsonb)
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    array(select jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(j, '[]'::jsonb))),
    array[]::text[]
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.interests_to_text_array(t text[])
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select coalesce(t, array[]::text[]);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.jsonb_to_text_array(j jsonb)
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    array(select jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(j, '[]'::jsonb))),
    array[]::text[]
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log1p_safe(x double precision)
 RETURNS double precision
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$ select ln(1.0 + greatest(0.0, x)); $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.minmax_norm(x double precision, xmin double precision, xmax double precision)
 RETURNS double precision
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$ select case when xmax > xmin then (x - xmin) / (xmax - xmin) else 0.0 end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_updated_at()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
begin
  new.updated_at = now();
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sv_components(now_ts timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(post_id uuid, sv_1h double precision, sv_24h double precision, sv_7d double precision)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  with p as (
    select
      p.post_id,
      p.created_at
    from public.purchases as p
    where p.is_refund  = false
      and p.is_suspect = false
      and p.created_at > now_ts - interval '8 days'
  )
  select
    post_id,
    sum( exp( -ln(2) * extract(epoch from (now_ts - created_at)) /   3600.0) ) as sv_1h,
    sum( exp( -ln(2) * extract(epoch from (now_ts - created_at)) /  86400.0) ) as sv_24h,
    sum( exp( -ln(2) * extract(epoch from (now_ts - created_at)) / (7*86400.0)) ) as sv_7d
  from p
  group by post_id;
$function$

SELECT p.id,
    p.title,
    p.created_at,
    mv.sv_1h,
    mv.sv_24h,
    mv.sv_7d
   FROM posts p
     LEFT JOIN sales_velocity_mv mv ON mv.post_id = p.id
  ORDER BY mv.sv_1h DESC NULLS LAST
 LIMIT 200;

SELECT post_id,
    GREATEST(0.0, avg(watch_time_ms)) AS avg_watch_ms,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN liked THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END) AS likes_24h,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN commented THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END) AS comments_24h
   FROM post_engagements
  WHERE created_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)
  GROUP BY post_id;

SELECT id AS post_id,
        CASE
            WHEN (now() - created_at) <= '02:00:00'::interval THEN 1.0
            WHEN (now() - created_at) <= '24:00:00'::interval THEN 0.4
            ELSE 0.0
        END AS freshness_boost
   FROM posts;

SELECT tag,
    count(*) AS uses
   FROM ( SELECT unnest(posts.hashtags) AS tag
           FROM posts) t
  GROUP BY tag
  ORDER BY (count(*)) DESC;
